A separate exact SymPy checker validates all 49 finite Gram entries and zonal polynomial identities. No finite test replaces the analytical general argument.

value.rationale: The result is a natural, complete, finite and checkable criterion for when gradient-enhanced sampling repairs singular scalar harmonic frames, strictly reducing needed moment exactness from scalar degree six to even moments of degree two and four. Necessity is established as well as sufficiency, and the symmetric icosahedron yields exact complementary four- and three-dimensional blind spaces and a unique perfectly conditioned mixing coefficient. This is structurally relevant to stable design-based harmonic sensing, rather than an isolated arithmetic test.
